title: IPO GMP Dekh Ke Apply Karte Ho? SEBI Alert #shorts

source.title: Advisory Regarding Unregulated Pre-listing Premium often called as Grey Market Premium (GMP) for Upcoming Initial Public Offers (IPOs) — PR No. 75/2026
source.issuer: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

hook.line: IPO GMP Pe SEBI Ka Red Alert!
hook.caption: IPO apply karne se pehle Grey Market Premium dekhte ho? SEBI ne 23 Nov ko red alert jaari kiya hai!
hook.tts: IPO apply करने से पहले Grey Market Premium देखते हो? रुक जाओ! SEBI ने इस पर red alert जारी किया है.

doc.name: SEBI Advisory · PR No. 75/2026
doc.caption: Official SEBI Press Release (23 Nov 2026): Upcoming IPOs ke Grey Market Premium (GMP) par seedhi chetavni.
doc.tts: यह है तेईस November दो हज़ार छब्बीस की SEBI press release, upcoming IPOs के unregulated Grey Market Premium पर.

points.title: GMP Unofficial & Unregulated
points.quote: Investors are hereby cautioned that such pre-listing premium figures are unofficial, unverified, and unregulated at which shares are supposedly traded before they are formally listed on a recognized stock exchange.
points.decoded: GMP unofficial, unverified & bina price-discovery process
points.caption: Point 1: SEBI kehta hai GMP figures unofficial aur unverified hain — koi settlement guarantee nahi. Par asli jhatka Point 2 mein hai...
points.tts: पहला point. SEBI साफ़ कहता है कि GMP आंकड़े unofficial और unverified हैं, और इनमें कोई settlement guarantee नहीं है. लेकिन असली झटका आगे है.

points.title: Platforms Par GMP Display Mana
points.quote: All SEBI-registered intermediaries and market participants are advised to refrain from publishing, displaying, or broadcasting GMP figures for IPOs on their websites, platforms, or any other communication channels-including email, SMS, and social media.
points.decoded: Brokers & intermediaries website, SMS, social pe GMP nahi dikhayenge
points.caption: Yahi bada twist hai: sabhi SEBI-registered intermediaries ko website, email, SMS aur social media par GMP dikhane se mana kiya gaya hai!
points.tts: यहीं बड़ा twist है! SEBI ने सभी registered intermediaries को अपनी website, email, SMS और social media पर GMP दिखाने से रुकने को कहा है.

points.title: Koi SEBI / ODR Madad Nahi
points.quote: Investors should note that in the event of any dispute arising from or relating to GMP transactions, none of the following regulatory recourses will be available:
points.decoded: GMP dispute mein SEBI, Exchange ya smartodr.in koi madad nahi
points.caption: Point 3: GMP transaction mein dispute ya fraud hua toh SEBI, Stock Exchange ya smartodr.in portal se zero protection milegi.
points.tts: तीसरा point. अगर GMP transaction में कोई विवाद या नुकसान हुआ, तो SEBI, Stock Exchange या smartodr portal से कोई मदद नहीं मिलेगी.

lines: GMP ko listing return ki guarantee mat maano
Sirf SEBI-registered apps & DRHP check karo
Kya IPO GMP ban hona chahiye? Comment karo!
asar.caption: Aap par asar: GMP dekh ke hype mein paisa mat lagao — company ka DRHP dekho. Comment mein batao, kya IPO GMP poori tarah ban hona chahiye?
asar.tts: आप पर असर. GMP देखकर hype में पैसा मत लगाओ, हमेशा company के fundamentals और DRHP देखो. Comment करके बताओ, क्या IPO GMP पूरी तरह बंद होना चाहिए?

outro.caption: Subscribe karo Unpaper aur IPO wale dost ko bhejo — warna agli baar bhi...
outro.tts: Subscribe करो Unpaper और IPO वाले दोस्त को भेजो, नहीं तो अगली बार भी...

cta.comment: Kya IPO GMP sites ban honi chahiye?
cta.question: Kaunsa document decode karein? Comment karo.

seo.title: IPO GMP Dekh Ke Apply Karte Ho? SEBI Alert #shorts
seo.description:
SEBI Advisory (23 Nov 2026): IPO Grey Market Premium (GMP) figures are unofficial, unverified & carry zero SEBI, Exchange or smartodr.in dispute protection!
Official SEBI Source: https://www.sebi.gov.in/media-and-notifications/press-releases/nov-2026/advisory-regarding-unregulated-pre-listing-premium-often-called-as-grey-market-premium-gmp-for-upcoming-initial-public-offers-ipos-_105942.html
Vote 'BAN?' in comments. #SEBI #IPOGMP #StockMarketIndia #RetailInvestors #Unpaper
seo.caption:
IPO apply karne se pehle GMP dekhte ho? 🚨 SEBI (23 Nov 2026) ne red alert jaari kiya:
1️⃣ GMP figures unofficial, unverified & unregulated hain
2️⃣ Registered intermediaries website/SMS/social par GMP nahi dikhayenge
3️⃣ Dispute par ZERO SEBI, Exchange ya smartodr.in protection!

IPO wale dost ko bhejo! #SEBI #IPOGMP #StockMarketIndia #RetailInvestors #Unpaper

viralBlueprint.outlierAngle: Retail investors treat IPO GMP like official listing profit forecasts, unaware SEBI just barred registered entities from broadcasting it and excluded GMP disputes from smartodr.in.
